alerte.texte: Build 197 starts here: everything merged since build 196 is below. You accepted seven Hick's law changes, and four agents on the Mac are building them.

depuis.texte: A lint rule now blocks the two ways of opening a page that skipped the double-tap guard. Found by the Hick's law audit.
Every pull request that changes the app must now show it breaks nothing (its regression study), or a check fails. Your request of 10/10.
Profile song chip and picker on mobile and web

On the map search, picking a suggestion writes its name in the bar, ready to be written over; the places follow the typing sooner and the flight takes 1.2 s instead of 2.4. Your TestFlight point; for the next build.

Messages and the Profile are prepared ahead while you rest on Amis, switched off by default. Measured on a cloud iPhone: off, it costs nothing; on, it slows nothing and makes launch lighter (12 network reads instead of 22). For the next build.
An official Take's video is removed only when the video site says it is gone twice, a day apart; one passing error no longer removes it for good. It reaches staging with the next server deploy.

claude.libelle: A Claude is fixing it here

enCours.sujet: Hick's law: the seven changes you accepted
enCours.ouEnEst: You accepted points 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10 and 12 of the Hick's law audit. Four Claude agents on the Mac build them, one pull request per point.
enCours.reste: Pictures before and after, two reviews, then merge.

enCours.sujet: Hick's law: new ideas for points 1, 2, 6 and 7
enCours.ouEnEst: Two agents draw other ideas for the four points you want redone: one starts from X, the other from Instagram and Apple.
enCours.reste: Added to the short Hick's law page, for your choice.

enCours.sujet: Map search suggestions follow every letter
enCours.ouEnEst: Suggestions come about three times sooner and follow every letter. Your remark: the search panel jumps up and down while typing. A version where it stays still is being made.
enCours.reste: Your choice on the new video, then merge.

enCours.sujet: Private profile shows friends, Takes and score
enCours.ouEnEst: You approved the pictures. The branch is being brought up to date with main, after a review found tests failing only because it was behind.
The wait before each lookup is gone. Still to do: the slow panel animation you saw, and suggestions that keep up with each letter despite the trip to Los Angeles.
enCours.reste: Measure with your Korean network delay, pictures, then your OK.

enCours.sujet: Explore pages going blank during quick changes
enCours.ouEnEst: The native fix works; a test is missing for one of its signals, and the before and after pictures are being made on a cloud Mac.
A video's first image goes from 649 ms to 20 ms with 40 % less data, but switched on it adds about 80 ms of JS jank per run.
enCours.reste: Find the extra jank, then measure again.

enCours.sujet: Taps lost when two arrive within one frame
enCours.ouEnEst: Two fingers overlapping on the same button count once, which is React Native's normal touch model; taps apart, even barely, both count.

On Replicas, on Muse Spark through OpenCode: harfang (mentions), vison (private profile), lemming (Explore), and the reviewers.
